windowsForDay.name: split-day check-ins (SSRC), evening with its own window
split day, bedtime after midnight
wake-up not known yet: only the early wake-up check-in
fixed windows, random prompts, open until the range ends
hybrid: wake-up to 11:00, a split segment, 20:00 to bedtime
hybrid without a known wake-up keeps the fixed slot
truncate: overlapping windows close when the next prompt fires; a range past midnight
defer (default): the next prompt waits until the previous window closes
defer with random prompts: drawn from what is left of the range; a range used up by then (open until its end) is skipped
in-bed event before the planned bedtime ends the evening check-in
in-bed event after the planned bedtime: the fallback (planned bedtime)
in-bed event outside the bed window or before wake-up is ignored
bed window past midnight: going to bed at 00:40 before a 01:00 planned bedtime
end on the next day at a clock time; an explicit next-day end later than 24 h
until the next day's wake-up, observed
until the next day's wake-up, not known yet: its fallback
usual wake-up range answerable throughout, prompted at the observed wake-up (SSRC)
prompt at wake-up: nothing observed, the usual wake-up + grace
prompt at wake-up: observed after the grace period, the usual wake-up + grace
prompt at wake-up: observed before the range opens, when it opens
usual wake-up from the participant's habitual time moves the morning range
prompt at wake-up without a usual wake-up or observation: not prompted; never prompted
answerable throughout the range, prompted at a random time inside it
prompt at wake-up, answerable from the prompt for the response window
parallel questionnaire open all day does not move the one-at-a-time check-ins
truncate closes the previous window, parallel windows are left alone
open from the prompt until the study day ends (legacy signal time)
days: from day 2, every 2nd day, weekdays only, until day 10
dates: no window opens before dateFrom or after dateUntil
event prompt: known, at the event; unknown and only open from it: left out; open throughout its range: silent
wake prompt without a usual wake-up is not known: left out unless open throughout
usual sleep times: evening around the planned bedtime, morning around the usual wake-up

resolveWakeTod.name: fixed fallback when nothing is observed
observed wake-up before the fallback wins (whole minutes)
observed after the fallback: the fallback, once it has passed
nothing observed and the fallback still ahead: unknown
outside the wake-up window is ignored
past day without any observation: the fallback

resolveEventTod.name: first event in the window, before the fallback
event after the fallback: the fallback
no event, fallback not reached: not known yet
random delay between 10 and 30 minutes, stable per seed

applyCompletions.name: the next check-in opens and is prompted an hour after the previous one was completed
a check-in the cool-down outlasts is missed
its own completion and others long before do not count; the same questionnaire earlier does
answerable before its prompt: opens after the cool-down, prompt unchanged when later
without a cool-down, completions change nothing
limits: window by key or time, day, once, none
a completion without a key counts for one window: the earliest it falls into
two completions without a key: both windows
minimum gap after completing the same questionnaire

availability.name: done: locked until the next window
